text:
sam_sales: Heads-up — NovaEdge wants a 2-week POC starting next Mon. Requirements: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM user provisioning + deprovisioning, group -> role mapping with precedence, domain verification for shared domains, and a short pricing comparison for Hosted vs Dedicated during the trial. Any immediate red flags?

ola_pm: Couple clarifying Qs: Are they ok with Hosted if we can guarantee EU data residency? Legal hinted they might ask for Private. Also ask if they need delegated tenant admins or just role-based admin screens.

devin_eng: For throughput they mentioned ~1.5k MAU and spikes to ~120r/s. Dedicated recommended for consistent latency, but Hosted can handle with throttles if they accept SLO variance. SCIM notes: we support a delta sync and a bulk-import CSV/NDJSON for first-load. Our SCIM rate limit defaults to 5 req/s, 429 backoff with exponential delay.

devin_eng: Example SCIM bulk payload sample we usually give partners:

```
POST /scim/v2/Bulk
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:BulkRequest"],
  "Operations": [
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/Users",
      "bulkId": "q1",
      "data": { "userName": "j.taylor@novaedge.com", "name": { "givenName": "Jesse", "familyName": "Taylor" }, "active": true }
    }
  ]
}
```

devin_eng: We'll include a staging endpoint for the POC to avoid hitting prod throttles. Also support SCIM PATCH for attribute updates.

carla_security: Security checklist: require SAML responses signed with SHA256, want encrypted attributes (AES-256). If they move to Private we need confirmation of KMS provider (AWS KMS or GCP KMS) and the HSM SLA if requested. I've sent our security questionnaire: https://redwood.ai/security-qa-form — ask them to return it before kickoff.

sam_sales: Customer prefers Hosted for speed. Legal insists on EU residency + data processing addendum. Can we host their tenant in EU region while still on Hosted?

devin_eng: Yes — we can pin tenant to eu-central region on Hosted. That covers residency but not full Private isolation. If they demand VPC/private control plane then we escalate to Private offering. Also note: we can map multiple verified domains to a single tenant and enforce domain-locked email claims. Domain proofing is via TXT record: create txt _rwdfd.novaedge.com with token value we provide.

ola_pm: They also asked whether a single Okta group can map to multiple roles and whether we support role hierarchies.

devin_eng: Single group -> multiple roles supported. We also support explicit role priority rules so conflicts resolve deterministically. We can demo group->role UI in the POC. Delegated admin: we have tenant-level admin roles that can be scoped to subset of actions, yes.

carla_security: SAML edgecases to call out: SP-initiated logout may not terminate session in their IdP if they keep long lived cookies. Recommend policy document for session TTL and re-auth requirements. Also confirm whether they require signed logout requests.

infra-bot: infra action: create-poc-namespace 1815001240: provisioned ephemeral pool (2x A10G) for staging POC — expires in 14 days.

sam_sales: Action items:
- Devin: quick pricing table comparing 2-week Dedicated reserved vs Hosted pay-as-you-go + estimated overages (include networking and EU hosting premium).
- Ola: draft SOW with success criteria (throughput, latency targets, auth flows to test).
- Carla: finalize security questionnaire items and share recommended SAML settings config.
- Devin: include SCIM bulk import guide and rate-limit guidance in SOW.

ola_pm: Can we have quote + SOW + sample SAML metadata + domain-verification token by Thu EOD? They'll need that to approve kickoff on Mon.

sam_sales: Yep — I'll push timeline with customer. Thanks team :heart:
